# PASCAL International Education

> > PASCAL International Education is a leading international school group in Cyprus offering Cambridge and IB curricula across three campuses for ages 3-18.

PASCAL operates three schools in Lefkosia, Larnaka, and Lemesos, providing a comprehensive international education pathway from kindergarten through secondary with IB World School accreditation and Globeducate membership. The institution emphasizes STEAM learning, global citizenship, and multiple exam qualifications including Cambridge, IGCSE, A Levels, and the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme.

- [Home - PASCAL International Education](https://www.pascal.ac.cy): PASCAL International Education homepage showcasing schools in Lefkosia, Larnaka, Lemesos for ages 3-18.

- [Our Schools in Cyprus](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/about/our-schools): PASCAL campuses in Lefkosia, Larnaka, Lemesos with educational pathways and exam qualifications.
- [Our Mission, Vision & Values](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/about/mission-vision-and-values): PASCAL's mission, vision, and values emphasizing lifelong learning and student development.
- [Governance & Leadership](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/about/governance-and-leadership): PASCAL leadership team and Globeducate Platinum Standard governance structure.
- [Member of Globeducate](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/about/a-proud-member-of-globeducate): PASCAL as Globeducate member emphasizing international education and global citizenship.

## Academic Programs

- [Kindergarten](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/teaching-learning/kindergarten-curriculum): PASCAL kindergarten Early Years Learning curriculum with seven areas of learning.
- [Primary School](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/teaching-learning/primary-curriculum): PASCAL Primary Cambridge curriculum with STEAM learning and Space Centre.
- [Secondary Day & Boarding School](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/teaching-learning/secondary-curriculum): PASCAL Secondary program offering Apolytirion, IGCSE, A Level, and IB qualifications.
- [GCE AS & A Levels](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/teaching-learning/secondary-curriculum/gce-as-and-a-levels): PASCAL GCE AS and A Level qualifications for secondary university preparation.
- [International Baccalaureate](https://www.pascal.ac.cy/teaching-learning/secondary-curriculum/ib-diploma-programme): PASCAL IB Diploma Programme at Lefkosia and Larnaka IB World Schools.
